caseName: Walsh v. First National Bank & Trust Co. of Scranton
caseNameFull: WALSH v. FIRST NATIONAL BANK & TRUST CO. OF SCRANTON, PA.
attorneys: Appellant pro se., Murdaugh Stuart Madden for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
